summary: End-to-end Playwright testing of Mukhtar Cloud Kitchen frontend. All critical flows PASS: home load, nav to menu, dish rendering, category filter, search, add-to-cart, cart drawer, unauthenticated checkout->login redirect, signup+auto-login->menu, authenticated checkout (address form + COD), order creation and redirect to /orders/{id}, order tracking stepper with step-placed active, admin login->/admin, admin dashboard tiles, /admin/menu (12 dishes with edit/delete testids), /admin/orders (orders table with status-select-{oid} dropdowns showing our newly-placed order).

issues: 'Beverages' category thumbnail image is broken/failed to load (renders empty grey box with alt text). Other 5 category images load fine.

action_items: Fix broken 'Beverages' category image on Home page (image URL returns error or is missing).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminMenu uses testids `admin-add-dish-btn` and `del-dish-{id}` — review request referenced `add-dish-btn`/`delete-dish-{id}`. Not a bug (dialog opens, delete works), but consider aligning naming conventions.
ProtectedRoute uses window.location.href for redirects (App.js:61-62) instead of react-router <Navigate>. Works but causes a full page reload; minor UX/state issue.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@mukhtar.com / Admin@123 (works). Customer signup created test_user_1785865957@example.com / Password123 for verification.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing seeded admin + fresh signup. 2 test COD orders were created on the seeded catalogue.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend E2E fully validated. Google OAuth and Razorpay UI intentionally skipped per request. Only cosmetic issue: broken Beverages category image on home page. All data-testid selectors used in review request work as expected.
